# The public check refuses root and needs the dev overlay; emulate its
# comparison logic directly against both fixtures instead.
import json, subprocess, sys
for name in ('smoke', 'empty'):
    got = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/campaign_cli.py'],
                         stdin=open('examples/%s.input.json' % name, 'rb'),
                         capture_output=True)
    exp = json.load(open('examples/%s.expected.json' % name))
    val = json.loads(got.stdout.decode())
    ok = json.dumps(val, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    print(name, 'rc=%d' % got.returncode, 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', got.stderr[:200])
EOF
